title: Новая пицца: динамический id
verify: SELECT id, pizzeria_id, pizza_name, price FROM menu ORDER BY id

positive.sql: INSERT INTO menu (id, pizzeria_id, pizza_name, price) SELECT MAX(menu.id) + 1, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Dominos'), 'sicilian pizza', 900 FROM menu;

negative.why: id вписан числом: на других данных будет неверный
negative.sql: INSERT INTO menu VALUES (20, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Dominos'), 'sicilian pizza', 900);
INSERT INTO menu VALUES ((SELECT MAX(id) FROM menu) + 1, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Dominos'), 'sicilian pizza', 90);
INSERT INTO menu VALUES ((SELECT MAX(id) FROM menu) + 1, (SELECT id FROM pizzeria WHERE name = 'Pizza Hut'), 'sicilian pizza', 900);
